name: Fallout
tagline: Environmental disasters: who caused them, who paid, who is still waiting.
scope: Industrial spills, explosions, pollution releases, climate-linked disasters with a corporate or regulatory failure, enforcement actions, penalties, cleanup and compensation status. Excludes weather events with no accountability angle.
major: a new disaster with deaths or large releases; a fine or settlement of $10M+; an agency enforcement or rollback on a named disaster; a court ruling on liability
watch: EPA and state enforcement dockets; NTSB/CSB reports; pending settlements and cleanup deadlines
search_queries: chemical spill OR explosion company cited
